feature_contract.goal: Restore one finite binocular +TIME stage-extension sprite and numeric presentation across original E8 producers, queued SpriteNodes, D3DX delayed batch boundaries and actual D3D GPU draw ownership.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only exact +TIME ScreenHud producer in active original D3DXSprite queue; do not flush other HUD, GOAL, ranks beyond existing R64 behavior, lens, world, SkyGlow, DX11, or DXVK.
trace_stages: All three original stage-extension sprani and three numeric print E8 calls plus direct ScreenHud scope.
Canonical queue per-node producer and ID3DXSprite Begin/Draw/Flush/End deferred submission.
Actual packaged R26 HUD FVF0x142/fixed-function plus VS/XYZRHW per-eye stereo output.
subcomponents: Pre-submit previous homogeneous D3DXSprite batch under its old queue producer BEFORE selecting exact stage node; reject unknown owner.
Flush exact queued +TIME sprite batch while its ScreenHud producer remains active, preserving HRESULT and legacy rank isolation.
Continue investigating direct numeric D3DX/VS/XYZRHW and Quest3 stereo before optical closure.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All three sprani and three numeric calls retain exact StageExtensionTime source and tagged SpriteNode/direct glyph ownership.
Known previous batch is submitted before owner change and exact stage batch is submitted while ScreenHud ownership is active.
Unknown or mixed previous batch is not silently promoted, legacy DispRank flushing and SkyGlow/world unaffected.
Windows x86 game and x64 OpenXR host package, Domain and applicable source impact pass at validation-bearing result SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original six E8 sources explicitly exist and stage scene tags are captured, but direct source-scoped callbacks end before D3DXSprite deferred Flush/End.
diagnosis.root_cause: A D3DXSprite batch can span selected SpriteNode producer transitions; ScreenHud scope on registration does not automatically survive until GPU submission.
source_trace: RVA 0x989xx sprani/numeric producers tag exact StageExtensionTime siblings.
Queue selects a new node and changes CurrentScope before queued D3DXSprite triangles necessarily reach D3D draw.
R64 existing exact rank-specific post-Draw flush does not isolate +TIME; raw GPU sees submission-time scope.
alternatives_rejected: Global Flush per Draw contaminates original texture/alpha ordering and incurs cost.
A simple post-Draw Flush without previous-owner separation can reclassify unrelated sprites.
HMD causality remains unproven until actual stage rendering with matching installed DLL.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Bounded exact +TIME queue boundary protects homogeneous prior owner and exact staged batch with Begin/End-aware fail-closed behavior.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Exact stage ScreenHud reaches existing R26+HUD full stereo paths; numeric direct D3DX ownership still requires cross-path check before feature closeout.

runtime_evidence: Quest3/VDXR test not performed. This is a source candidate; direct numeric batching and HMD visibility not yet verified.
